title: Thaumic Periphery Fix
description: Mod designed to resolve a crash issue between Thaumic Periphery and Embers UEL on server side
body:
# Thaumic Periphery Fix

This is a mod for Minecraft 1.12.2 designed to resolve a crash issue between Thaumic Periphery and Embers UEL on server versions. 

**WORKS ONLY WITH CLEANROOM**

**REQUIRES [THAUMIC PERIPHERY](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/thaumic-periphery) AND [EMBERS UEL](https://modrinth.com/mod/embers-unofficial-extended-life)**

## Features
- Fixes compatibility issues between Thaumic Periphery and Embers UEL.
- Ensures server stability when both mods are installed.

## Installation
1. Place the `peripheryfix-1.0.0.jar` file into the `mods` folder of your Minecraft server.
2. Start the server to apply the fix.

## Compatibility

- **Cleanroom 1.12.2**
- Mods: Thaumic Periphery, Embers UEL

## Credits
Developed by shadowking21.

## Support
For issues or questions, please open an issue in the repository or contact the developer.
